newsitem.title: USA: GAO upholds Government Technology army contract.
newsitem.headline: GAO upholds Government Technology army contract.

text.p: Government Technology Services Inc said Wednesday that the General Accounting Office sustained the U.S. Department of the Army's initial award of the Portable II contract to GTSI and another company.
Several bidding companies that did not receive awards had earlier protested the awards to the GAO, said the company. The Army estimates the awards carry a combined value of $236.7 million.

GTSI said it will begin immediate performance of the two year indefinite delivery/indefinite quantity contract for the supply of computer products to the Army, certain other defense and all civilian agencies.
GTSI is a computer products reseller.
